title: 💰 Money Week
description: Учим Present Perfect vs Past Simple и деньги с юмором

days.title: Day 1: Денежные глаголы & Present Perfect
days.description: 12 глаголов о деньгах и основы Present Perfect

grammar.title: Present Perfect (настоящее совершенное время)
grammar.rule:
Используйте Present Perfect (have/has + глагол в 3-й форме), когда:

✅ Говорите о жизненном опыте (неважно, когда именно): 'Я копил деньги когда-то'
✅ Действие произошло недавно, но время не указано: 'Я только что заплатил'
✅ Результат важен сейчас: 'Я накопил €500, и могу купить эту классную куртку'

❌ НЕ используйте, если есть точное время (yesterday, last week, in 2020) — там Past Simple!
examples: I have saved €500 this year. (Моя копилка очень счастлива 🐷)
She has never borrowed money. (Она скорее продаст старые носки на eBay, чем займёт 🧦)
Have you ever inherited money? (Жду звонка от богатого дяди... 📞)
grammar.keywords: ever, never, already, yet, just, since, for

vocabulary.example: borrow money from a friend (and then avoid them for a month 😅)
lend money to someone — say goodbye to that money 👋
save money in a piggy bank (and resist the urge to break it open)
waste money on things you don't need (like a gold-plated toothbrush)
earn a salary (and wonder where it all went by Monday)
owe money to the bank — they never forget 😬
inherit a fortune (if you're lucky enough to have a rich great-aunt)
charge for a service (my cat charges me in treats 🐱)
afford a new house — maybe in another lifetime
cost an arm and a leg (literally, if you don't have insurance)
invest in stocks — or in a good pizza. Pizza never loses value 🍕
raise money for charity (or for your own coffee addiction ☕)

exercises.question: Can I _________ €20 from you until Friday? (I promise I'll pay you back... maybe)
exercises.explanation: Borrow = взять взаймы. Lend = дать взаймы. Не перепутайте, иначе дружба под угрозой! 🤝

exercises.question: I need to _________ some money for a new laptop. (My old one sounds like a helicopter 🚁)
exercises.explanation: Save = копить. Waste = тратить на ерунду. Выбор за вами!

exercises.question: She _________ £2,000 a month in her new job. (And she still can't afford a coffee in London ☕)
exercises.explanation: Earn = зарабатывать. Owe = быть должным. Надеюсь, она зарабатывает больше, чем должна!

exercises.question: I _______________ (save) €800 this year. (My piggy bank is getting heavy 🐷)
exercises.explanation: Present Perfect! Время не указано, важен результат.

exercises.question: She _______________ (already / inherit) a fortune. (Lucky her! Meanwhile, I inherited my grandma's cat 🐱)
exercises.explanation: Has already inherited — 'already' ставим между have/has и глаголом.

days.title: Day 2: Past Simple & Повторение
days.description: Практикуем Past Simple и повторяем денежные глаголы

grammar.title: Past Simple (простое прошедшее время)
grammar.rule:
Используйте Past Simple, когда действие закончилось в прошлом и ЕСТЬ точное время или контекст:

✅ Вчера, на прошлой неделе, в 2010 году, 5 минут назад
❌ НЕ используйте, если время не указано или важен результат (там Present Perfect)

🎯 Простое правило: есть точное время → Past Simple. Нет времени → Present Perfect.
examples: I borrowed £50 yesterday. (И теперь мой друг не отвечает на звонки 📱)
She lent me £20 last week. (Я до сих пор пытаюсь вспомнить, зачем мне были нужны эти £20)
They bought a car in 2015. (И с тех пор продали почку, чтобы её обслуживать 🚗)

vocabulary.example: pay by credit card (and cry when you see the bill 😭)
pay for dinner (and pretend you didn't see the price)
spend money on clothes (and wear them once)
invest in property (or in a really nice tent ⛺)
lend to a friend (kiss your money goodbye 👋)
borrow from a bank (and then avoid their calls)

exercises.question: I _________ £50 from my friend yesterday. (He still doesn't know I spent it on a talking fish 🐠)
exercises.explanation: Past Simple! 'Yesterday' — точное время в прошлом.

exercises.question: She _________ me £20 last week. (I should probably pay her back... eventually)
exercises.explanation: Lent — неправильный глагол, в Past Simple форма 'lent'.

exercises.question: I have seen him yesterday.
exercises.explanation: Ошибка! 'Yesterday' требует Past Simple, а не Present Perfect. 'I saw him yesterday' — правильно.

exercises.question: They _______________ (move) to London in 2015. (Bad timing — just before rent prices exploded 📈)
exercises.explanation: Past Simple. 'In 2015' — конкретный год в прошлом.

days.title: Day 3: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
days.description: Сравниваем оба времени — когда что использовать

grammar.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple — Битва титанов
grammar.rule:
🎯 Главное отличие — есть точное время или нет?

Present Perfect (опыт/результат, время НЕ указано):
• 'I have visited Paris' — был когда-то в жизни, неважно когда
• 'She has never been in debt' — опыт

Past Simple (конкретный факт, время УКАЗАНО):
• 'I visited Paris in 2019' — конкретный год
• 'She was in debt last year' — конкретный период

💡 Лайфхак: видите yesterday, last week, in 2010, ago → Past Simple. Нет времени или есть ever/never/just/already/yet → Present Perfect.
examples: I have visited Paris. (Опыт. Айфелева башня была красивой, но очереди... 🗼)
I visited Paris in 2019. (Конкретный год. Тогда я ещё мог позволить себе круассан 🥐)
She has never been in debt. (Как ей это удаётся? Тайна века 🤯)
She was in debt last year. (Но теперь она свободна! Почти... 💪)
grammar.keywords: Present Perfect: ever, never, already, yet, since, for | Past Simple: yesterday, last week, in 2010, ago

vocabulary.definition: money you owe for a service (and wish you never ordered that appetizer 🍟)
a plan for spending money (that you ignore by Tuesday)
money borrowed from a bank (and then they own your soul)
a loan to buy a house (say goodbye to your salary for 30 years 🏠)
money earned from work (that disappears like magic by the 5th of the month ✨)

exercises.question: I _____ to Paris three times in my life. (And I still can't speak French 🇫🇷)
exercises.explanation: Present Perfect — жизненный опыт. Неважно, когда именно.

exercises.question: She _____ a new phone yesterday. (Her old one finally gave up after 7 years 📱💀)
exercises.explanation: Past Simple — 'yesterday' точное время.

exercises.question: I _______________ (never / be) to Japan. (But I've eaten a lot of sushi 🍣)
exercises.explanation: Present Perfect + never — для опыта.

exercises.question: They _______________ (get) married in 2010. (And they're still happy! Or maybe just good at hiding it 😄)
exercises.explanation: Past Simple — 'in 2010' конкретный год.

days.title: Day 4: Денежные существительные & Фразовые глаголы
days.description: Учим существительные о деньгах и популярные фразовые глаголы

grammar.title: Повторение: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
grammar.rule:
🎯 Напоминаю главное правило:
• Present Perfect (have/has + V3) — для опыта и результата. Время НЕ указано.
• Past Simple (V2/ed) — для конкретных фактов. Время УКАЗАНО.

Если сомневаетесь — посмотрите на слово-подсказку (yesterday, ever, never, ago, last week, already, yet).
examples: I have taken out a loan. (Опыт. И теперь банк звонит каждый день 📞)
I took out a loan last year. (Конкретный год. С тех пор я экономлю на кофе ☕)

vocabulary.example: take out a loan (and then take out another to pay the first one)
pay back the money (in another lifetime maybe)
live on a small salary (ramen noodles, anyone? 🍜)
save up for a car (should take only 47 years 🚗)
cut back on spending (goodbye, daily avocado toast 🥑)
get by on minimum wage (barely, but somehow)

exercises.question: I need to take _____ a loan to buy a house. (Or a cardboard box, depending on the loan amount 📦)
exercises.explanation: Take out a loan = взять кредит. Out — правильная частица.

exercises.question: Can I pay you _____ next week? (I promise I'm good for it... probably)
exercises.explanation: Pay back = вернуть долг. Не забудьте! 🤝

exercises.question: Many students live _____ their parents. (It's not ideal, but the fridge is always full 🍕)
exercises.explanation: Live off = жить за чей-то счёт. Off — правильная частица.

exercises.question: I'm saving _____ for a new phone. (My current one has more cracks than a broken mirror 📱💔)
exercises.explanation: Save up = копить на что-то. Up — правильная частица.

days.title: Day 5: Collocations & Аудирование
days.description: Практикуем устойчивые выражения с деньгами и слушаем диалоги

grammar.title: Практика смешанных времён
grammar.rule:
Выбирайте время в зависимости от того, указано ли точное время действия.

📌 Present Perfect (нет времени / опыт / результат):
• I have never borrowed money.
• She has already paid the bill.

📌 Past Simple (есть yesterday, last week, in 2010, ago):
• I borrowed €50 yesterday.
• She paid the bill an hour ago.

vocabulary.example: make money online (from the comfort of your bed 🛌)
lose money on stocks (but gain wisdom? No, just regret 📉)
waste money on gambling (or on that 'revolutionary' juicer 🥤)
save money on groceries (by eating what's in the back of the fridge 🧀)
borrow money from a friend (and then avoid them for a month)
lend money to a relative (and kiss it goodbye 👋)
pay cash for the car (feel like a boss for 5 seconds 💪)
pay interest on a loan (the bank's favourite word 🏦)

exercises.question: I need to _____ a loan from the bank. (Wish me luck — they're not very friendly 😬)
exercises.explanation: Take out a loan — правильное устойчивое выражение.

exercises.question: What does Mark want to buy? (Listen carefully — his dreams are expensive 💭)
exercises.explanation: Mark says: 'I'm thinking about buying a new car.' Он мечтает о машине!
exercises.listeningText: 🎧 Mark: I'm thinking about taking out a loan to buy a new car. Lisa: Have you saved up enough? Mark: I've saved £2,000, but the car costs £10,000. Lisa: That's a big difference! Mark: I know... maybe I should look at cheaper cars. Or win the lottery. 🍀

exercises.question: How much did Lisa borrow for her holiday? (She really wanted that beach vacation 🏖️)
exercises.explanation: Lisa says: 'I borrowed £3,000.' А потом пожалела...
exercises.listeningText: 🎧 Lisa: I borrowed £3,000 for my holiday in Thailand. The interest was so high — I ended up paying back £4,000! Mark: Ouch. Was it worth it? Lisa: The holiday was amazing. The debt, not so much. 🇹🇭

days.title: Day 6: Reading & Финальная практика
days.description: Читаем о финансовых привычках со всего мира

grammar.title: Финальное повторение
grammar.rule: Тест на знание времён и денежной лексики. Вспоминайте правила и не бойтесь ошибаться — на ошибках учимся! 💪

vocabulary.example: open a bank account (and get a free toaster 🍞)
close an old account (like breaking up with a bank 💔)
withdraw money from an ATM (and hope it doesn't eat your card)
deposit money into savings (out of sight, out of mind)
transfer money online (without leaving your couch 🛋️)
exchange currency at the airport (worst rates ever ✈️)

exercises.question: How do many Germans prefer to pay? (They're not fans of plastic money 💶)
exercises.explanation: The text says: 'Many Germans prefer to save money and pay in cash.' Наличные — король в Германии!
exercises.readingText:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📖 THE WEIRDEST MONEY HABITS AROUND THE WORLD
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 GERMANY
Did you know that in Germany, many people still pay with cash — even for a €500 purchase? They say "Cash is king" and hate credit cards.

📍 SWEDEN
Meanwhile, in Sweden, you can pay with a microchip under your skin. Yes, really! 😱

📍 JAPAN
In Japan, tipping is considered rude. If you leave extra money, the waiter might run after you to give it back. Awkward!

📍 UNITED KINGDOM
In the UK, people love to complain about money but never actually do anything about it. "Mustn't grumble" is the national motto.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💭 WHAT ABOUT YOU?
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Do you save your coins in a piggy bank or spend everything on Friday night?

One thing is certain: money makes the world go round — but also makes people a little bit crazy. 🤪

exercises.question: What is the key to financial health according to experts? (Spoiler: it's not winning the lottery 🎰)
options: Having a budget and saving regularly
exercises.correct: Having a budget and saving regularly
exercises.explanation: Experts agree: бюджет + регулярные сбережения = финансовое здоровье. Скучно, но работает! 📊

exercises.question: I _______________ (never / be) in debt. (Are you a wizard? How do you do it? 🧙)
exercises.explanation: Present Perfect + never — для опыта за всю жизнь.

grammar.title: Финальная проверка
grammar.rule: Вы готовы? Пройдите все 10 упражнений и получите сертификат (виртуальный, но очень почётный 🎓). Удачи!

exercises.question: Can I _____ £50 from you? (I'll be your best friend forever 🤞)
exercises.explanation: Borrow = занять у кого-то. Lend = дать в долг. Не перепутайте!

exercises.question: She _____ me £20 yesterday. (And I still haven't paid her back... oops 😬)
exercises.explanation: Lent — прошедшее время от lend (давать в долг).

exercises.question: I can't _____ a new car right now. (My budget says 'no', but my heart says 'maybe?' 💔)
exercises.explanation: Afford = позволить себе (иметь достаточно денег).

exercises.question: A _____ is a loan to buy a house. (Also known as 'goodbye, salary for 30 years' 🏠)
exercises.explanation: Mortgage = ипотека. Долгосрочные отношения с банком.

exercises.question: I _____ a new phone last week. (My old one finally died after 5 years of loyal service 📱⚰️)
exercises.explanation: Past Simple — 'last week' точное время.

exercises.question: She _____ never _____ to Japan. (But she's been to the Japanese restaurant down the street 🍣)
exercises.explanation: Present Perfect + never = опыт за всю жизнь.

exercises.question: I need to take _____ a loan. (And then cry about it for the next 5 years 😭)
exercises.explanation: Take out a loan — правильный фразовый глагол.

exercises.question: Can I pay you _____ next week? (I promise I'm good for it... probably)
exercises.explanation: Pay back = вернуть долг.

exercises.question: I _______________ (save) €500 this year. (My piggy bank is getting heavier every day 🐷)
exercises.explanation: Present Perfect — результат важен, время не указано.

exercises.question: They _______________ (move) to London in 2015. (Bad timing — just before rent exploded 📈)
exercises.explanation: Past Simple — 'in 2015' конкретный год.
